Messages.Body:
If I got it right, Pulled Fang is played during the Press phase
Does that mean that the aggravated damae it bestowes is
unpreventable ? Even with a flack jacket ?
Second question: if a vampire should go to torpor because he received
more damages than he had blood, can the opponent play Pulled Fang to burn
the vampire ?

== Herve Guillemet
Intuisys / INSERM U66

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
guil...@marsouin.imed.jussieu.fr (Herve Guillemet) writes:

>If I got it right, Pulled Fang is played during the Press phase
>Does that mean that the aggravated damae it bestowes is
>unpreventable ? Even with a flack jacket ?

No, Flak Jackets (and other permanents, or permanent-style effects
like Flesh of Marble) can be implemented throughout the round.
Damage prevention cards can only be played during strike resolution (for
some reason known only to the Rules Team).

>Second question: if a vampire should go to torpor because he received
>more damages than he had blood, can the opponent play Pulled Fang to burn
>the vampire ?

Only if the previous damage had been done during the Press Step as well,
since the press step will not be reached if the vamp goes to torpor during
strike resolution.
